reply.text: I like the goal. Before I say anything about how to get there, let me pull up your squat history so we're starting from your real numbers. Nothing is logged for squats yet, so I don't have a starting number to work from. That's fine, we can build one. Tell me your current best squat for a set of 5 or so, or a rep count at a weight you know, and I'll tell you what a realistic timeline looks like. Once you log your squats in the app, I can track the climb against that goal. A 50 lb gain is a real, multi-month project, so the way to get there is steady progress and consistent sessions, not one big push.
